method: Manual inspection of final Python-rendered PNGs at whole-figure and individual a/b/c panels; automated audits on exact final PDFs

figures.name: s1a_r2_1_strata
figures.review: All three panels retain signed LOW/MID/HIGH bars, explicit n, same y scale; 1981 adverse MID/HIGH and tiny LOW contributions visible.

figures.name: s1a_r2_2_concentration
figures.review: All three year curves use same 0–365 x and 0–103 y ranges; top5/10/20 orange points remain, no independence claim.

figures.name: s1a_r2_3_orthogonal
figures.review: All three panels show both Monthly/F2 and between/within signed values on identical y scales; 1983 F2 adverse within retained.

figures.name: s1a_r2_4_year_swap
figures.review: All six donors/self in each year and both frozen baselines shown on identical y ranges; real filled, controls hollow; 1980 adverse donor retained.

figures.name: s1a_r2_5_four_cell
figures.review: All four cells for both LOW masks retained per year with n and common y limits; 1981 F2 degradation visible; A/B and C/D references explicit.

readability: No clipped marks/labels, legends separated, all years/controls visible; 183mm design, minimum font verified by PDF audit
